entities.summary: Colin Bass is an English musician, singer, songwriter and record producer. Since 1979, he has been a member of the British progressive rock band Camel, who, after a ten-year hiatus due to the ill health of bandleader Andrew Latimer, returned to active touring in 2013. From 1984 to 1992, he was also a core figure in the pioneering world music group 3 Mustaphas 3. He has also made two solo albums under his own name and three albums recorded in Indonesia under the name Sabah Habas Mustapha. The title track of the first, "Denpasar Moon", became a hugely popular song in Indonesia in the mid-1990s and has been covered by over 50 Indonesian, Malaysian, Japanese and Filipino artists.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a member of Camel and 3 Mustaphas 3, Colin Bass contributed to the development of world music in the 1980s, with his song 'Denpasar Moon' being covered by over 50 artists across Southeast Asia. This helped popularize Indonesian culture globally.
